description: The tolerances of the outside comparisons that mart.oracle_outcomes records (#1523). A comparator names one comparison. A row stores the tolerance it was judged by, so a changed tolerance never rewrites an old row.

operator_listed_units.explanation: The index operator quotes a market value and a last sale price per listing. Their quotient is the listed unit count at the operator's own price. The tolerance of 5% passes the drift of a filed share count against a live quote (buybacks, an issue since the filing) and fails a unit error: an ADS ratio of 4 or a class counted twice (ratio 2).
